name: Yvette Farthing
summary: In Brill, Yvette Farthing shares the Gallows' End Tavern with her father, Coleman. A Forsaken, she carries the memory of a love cut short by the Scourge.

sections.title: Echoes of the Mills
sections.body: Yvette loved Thurman Agamand, heir to the prosperous Agamand Mills, before the Third War ruined Lordaeron. As the Scourge plague drew near, Yvette and her father, Coleman, begged Thurman to leave the estate with them. He refused, devoted to his family's legacy. Yvette and Thurman both perished and rose into undeath. Yvette found a place among the free-willed Forsaken in Brill, but she did not know Thurman's final fate.

sections.title: A Final Farewell
sections.body: Thurman wrote Yvette an urgent love letter before the mills fell. In it, he described his brother Devlin's treachery and lamented his choice to stay. The Scourge intercepted the letter, and it lay lost among the ruins of Agamand Mills until adventurers recovered it. Reading Thurman's dying confession brings Yvette a brief, genuine despair from her mortal life. She then forces herself back into cold detachment, bitter that past attachments have no place in the grim reality of the Forsaken.

faq.answer: Yvette Farthing is a Forsaken woman living in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. She is Coleman Farthing's daughter and lived in the farmlands of Tirisfal Glades before the Third War destroyed the kingdom.

faq.q: What is Yvette's connection to Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: Yvette loved Thurman Agamand. When the plague threatened the region, she tried to persuade him to flee with her, but he chose to remain and defend his family's estate.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver Thurman's letter to her?
faq.answer: Reading Thurman's long-lost letter leaves Yvette briefly crushed by sorrow at his final words of love and betrayal. She quickly hardens her manner, saying that she is Forsaken now and mortal sentiment is useless.
Yvette's father is Coleman Farthing, a Forsaken who also lives in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. They first fled together, but both eventually succumbed to the plague and became Forsaken.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may carry human memories of love even as undeath hardens the heart.
